articles.title: AMAs 2026 Winners List: See Which Celebrity Artists Won Awards (Updating Live)
articles.summary: The 2026 American Music Awards are scheduled to be hosted at the iconic MGM Grand Garden Arena in Las Vegas. This prestigious event is set to attract a diverse lineup of celebrity music artists, including both acclaimed veteran performers and promising rising stars within the industry. The ceremony traditionally celebrates significant achievements and contributions to the world of music, making it a key international cultural event.

articles.title: South Korea showcases flagship submarine in British Columbia for Canadian navy
articles.summary: South Korea's submarine fleet flagship is currently docked in British Columbia, Canada, serving as a 'floating floor model.' This engagement likely involves a naval exhibition or defence industry demonstration, showcasing South Korea's advanced maritime capabilities. For SSB aspirants, it highlights international defence diplomacy and the importance of naval power projection in fostering global security partnerships.
